newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Pao de Acucar cut.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Pao de Acucar cut.

text.p: HSBC James Capel analyst Luiz Ernesto Godinho cut his rating for Brazilian food retailer Pao de Acucar Thursday to long-term buy from buy.
-- He said in a research report that he reduced earnings estimates "after a slowdown in sales growth in June caused by the closing of a bridge in Sao Paulo."
-- The estimate of 1997 earnings for Pao de Acucar -- also known as Companhia Brasileira de Distribuicao -- was cut to $132.9 million from $138.8 million, or $1.73 per 1,000 shares.
-- The company's American Depositary Receipts were off 7/16 to 22-1/16 in New York.
